visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a grey mini-dress with a white collar, jumping energetically onto a large, white curved sofa in a modern living room. Her mouth is wide open in a laugh, and her hands are spread out for balance. Behind her, a large window reveals a sprawling urban skyline under bright daylight. (2) She sits on the sofa, smoothing the fabric with her hands and looking toward someone off-camera with a bright, squinting smile. A man in a black shirt appears briefly on the left, interacting with her. The lighting is soft and bright, highlighting the clean lines of the interior. (3) The scene shifts to a bedroom where the woman is sitting on a bed with white and grey bedding. She runs her hand across the mattress, demonstrating its softness while maintaining a joyful facial expression. (4) A man is shown lying inside the storage compartment of a lifted bed frame, laughing. The woman looks down at him, surprised and amused. The lighting is warm from a nearby hanging globe lamp. (5) The woman and two men are now in a kitchen/dining area with light wood cabinetry. One man in a black shirt gestures toward the woman while she laughs, leaning against a counter. (6) They are seen crouching on a light-colored wooden floor. A man in a tan polo shirt points at the floorboards, demonstrating a feature while the woman watches closely. (7) The woman holds a folded white towel or blanket, presenting it to the camera with a cheerful expression. One of the men reaches out to touch the fabric. (8) Back in the living room, the woman says a command, and the motorized curtains automatically close, darkening the room and highlighting the smart home integration. (9) The group gathers in the hallway, looking at a wall-mounted electronic device. They are all smiling and engaged in a lively conversation, with the woman gesturing toward the man in the tan shirt.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-energy electronic pop track with a fast BPM. A female voice speaks with very high arousal and a cheerful tone, punctuated by a metallic 'ding' sound effect. There is a slight fabric rustle as she jumps. (2) A male voice enters with a loud, resonant laugh, creating a collaborative conversational texture. A quick 'whoosh' SFX signals a scene transition. The background music maintains a consistent, driving beat. (3) The female continues describing the furniture with rapid speech and rising intonation. Another comedic 'boing' sound effect plays when a man is discovered under the bed. (4) The ambient noise remains very clean, with low-level room tone. Multiple voices overlap in a joyous banter, accompanied by a cartoonish 'pop' sound effect for emphasis on a variety caption. (5) The music shifts slightly in melody but stays high-tempo. The female voice performs a Siri command with clear articulation, followed by a mechanical whirring sound of motorized curtains, though the BGM mostly masks it.
